query_slice.window: fiscal_year=2025 AND (upper(agency_name) like '%COMMUNITY BOARD%' OR upper(agency_name) like '%COMMUNITY BD%')

staff_count.grain: published FY payroll rows with leave_status_as_of_june_30=ACTIVE
staff_count.note: ACTIVE staff_count is the published FY payroll-row count at fiscal-year close.

title_context.grain: publisher title_description with published-row counts; not a unique-person roster

payroll_dollars.grain: publisher dollar fields summed by exact board for the selected fiscal year, shown separately for ACTIVE and all published rows
payroll_dollars.note: These are Citywide Payroll pay fields, not adopted budget, personnel budget, registered value, payments, or unique-person compensation.

field_meanings.leave_status_as_of_june_30: Status of employee as of the close of the relevant fiscal year: Active, Ceased, or On Leave.
field_meanings.title_description: Civil service title description of the employee.
field_meanings.regular_gross_paid: Amount paid for base salary during the fiscal year.
field_meanings.total_ot_paid: Total overtime pay paid during the fiscal year.
field_meanings.total_other_pay: Compensation in addition to gross salary and overtime pay, including differentials, lump sums, allowances, retroactive pay, settlements, and bonus pay when applicable.
